content: On invocation of EthTSyn_RxIndication() the ingress time stamp shall be retrieved for t4 on ingress of the Pdelay_Resp message from the StbM via StbM_GetCurrent VirtualLocal Time() according to Figure 6 , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to FALSE .

On invocation of EthTSyn_RxIndication() the ingress time stamp shall be retrieved for t4 on ingress of the Pdelay_Resp message from the StbM via StbM_GetCurrent VirtualLocal Time() according to Figure 5 , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to FALSE .
